data.name: Chocolate makes you happy 7
data.detailed_description:
Chocolate makes you happy 7 is a colorful 2D physics puzzle game that combines delicious sweets, cookie-balancing challenges, laser obstacles, reverse gravity, moving treadmills, jumpers, teleports, accelerators, dangerous traps, and explosive surprises. Explore a playful world of chocolate and cookies, experiment with physics-based mechanics, and discover clever solutions in this entertaining collection of casual puzzle challenges.

Enter a delightful universe where cookies, chocolate, and physics come together to create an engaging puzzle-solving experience. Every level challenges you to observe the environment, anticipate how objects move and interact, and find the right way to keep your cookies safely positioned on a chocolate bar.

Your objective is simple but surprisingly challenging: keep the cookies on the chocolate bar for a certain amount of time to complete each level. Pay attention to balance, positioning, movement, and timing as you work toward your goal. What appears to be an easy task quickly becomes an entertaining physics brain teaser filled with unexpected interactions and tricky obstacles.

Discover creative puzzle-solving possibilities with reverse gravity, treadmills, jumpers, teleports, and accelerators. Changing gravity affects the movement of objects, treadmills introduce moving surfaces, jumpers create bouncing challenges, teleports provide alternative movement possibilities, and accelerators add speed-based interactions. Experiment with these mechanics, anticipate the movement of cookies, and find effective ways to maintain the perfect balance.

Face additional challenges with laser obstacles, dangerous traps, and explosions. These hazards introduce another layer of difficulty, encouraging careful observation, precise timing, and creative problem-solving. Learn how different environmental elements interact and discover the best approach to each physics puzzle.

With 50 levels of sweet physics puzzles, Chocolate makes you happy 7 offers an entertaining combination of casual gameplay, gravity-based challenges, moving surfaces, obstacle avoidance, and precision-based problem-solving. Every level invites you to experiment with physics, overcome tricky hazards, and experience the satisfaction of successfully balancing cookies on a chocolate bar.

Immerse yourself in the cheerful atmosphere of colorful minimalist art, where vibrant colors, playful sweets, and abstract 2D visuals create a charming and recognizable style. The chocolate-and-cookie theme adds personality to the experience while keeping the focus on challenging physics puzzles.

Whether you enjoy casual puzzle games, challenging physics puzzles, gravity puzzles, cute food-themed games, or minimalist brain teasers, Chocolate makes you happy 7 offers an accessible yet rewarding single-player experience. Experiment with gravity changes, master moving treadmills and jumpers, navigate teleports, and overcome lasers and explosive obstacles.

With its vibrant 2D graphics, enjoyable background soundtrack, and easy-to-understand objectives, Chocolate makes you happy 7 delivers a playful puzzle experience where simple rules meet challenging physics. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts, casual gamers, and players who enjoy logic challenges filled with chocolate, cookies, and unexpected surprises.

Key Features

  • 50 challenging puzzle levels – Solve colorful physics puzzles that test your logic, patience, timing, and precision.

  • Physics-based puzzle gameplay – Experiment with movement, positioning, gravity, and balance to discover effective solutions.

  • Cookie-balancing challenges – Keep cookies on a chocolate bar long enough to complete each level.

  • Laser obstacles (Lazors) – Encounter laser-based hazards that introduce additional challenges to the puzzle environments.

  • Reverse gravity mechanics – Change gravity to influence the movement of objects and solve physics-based challenges.

  • Moving treadmills and conveyor belts – Navigate moving surfaces that affect cookie movement and positioning.

  • Jumpers and bouncing interactions – Encounter jumpers that introduce additional movement and balance challenges.

  • Teleportation puzzles – Explore levels featuring teleports that create alternative movement possibilities.

  • Accelerators and speed challenges – Discover elements that increase movement speed and require careful timing.

  • Dangerous traps – Overcome hazardous obstacles that make maintaining the perfect balance more challenging.

  • Explosions and surprises – Encounter explosive elements that add excitement and variety to the gameplay.

  • Delicious chocolate theme – Enjoy playful environments inspired by chocolate bars, cookies, and colorful sweets.

  • Logic puzzles and brain teasers – Exercise your problem-solving skills, concentration, and attention to detail.

  • Balance and precision challenges – Observe how cookies behave and carefully maintain their position.

  • Colorful minimalist art – Enjoy vibrant 2D graphics with a cheerful abstract visual style.

  • Engaging background music – Enjoy an entertaining soundtrack throughout your sweet puzzle adventure.

  • Simple but challenging objectives – Easy-to-understand goals combined with creative physics mechanics.

  • 99 Steam Achievements – Unlock achievements throughout your puzzle-solving journey.

  • Steam Cloud support – Keep your progress synchronized across supported devices.

  • Single-player puzzle experience – Experiment with physics, discover solutions, and complete challenges at your own pace.

Balance the cookies. Reverse gravity. Master the treadmills. Avoid the lasers. Overcome the traps. Discover another delicious collection of physics puzzles in Chocolate makes you happy 7!
